name: FreeAI Go
description: Free directory for discovering and comparing AI tools for chat, images, writing, voice, video and APIs. Browse curated collections, check provider free-access limits, save a shortlist and open official sites. FreeAI Go does not host AI models or generate content; listed providers set their own prices and quotas. Available in English and Chinese.
